sourceChecks.note: The corrected exact official page independently validates C048.807.44.051.01, the CHF 925 Swiss offer, new/current status, 104 g full weight, titanium case and bracelet, 38 x 13.22 x 45.01 mm geometry, 19 mm lug width, Powermatic 80.611 automatic movement, 80-hour reserve, 300 m ISO 6425:2018 diver rating, BG W9 Super-LumiNova on hands, indices, and bezel, sapphire crystal, quick release, and extreme shock resistance. It does not publish a numerical rate tolerance.
Certina's exact one-page product sheet independently corroborates the reference, materials, movement, reserve, quick-release bracelet, lume, crystal, and dimensions.

The exact product page links this official manual, which says it applies to all Certina mechanical watches. It describes most non-chronometer watches as having an average accuracy tolerance of around -10/+30 seconds per day, but 'most' and 'around' do not establish an exact-reference guaranteed lower and upper bound for C048.807.44.051.01, so the accuracy gate remains open.

Retrieved 2026-08-30 after a narrow Perplexity source-discovery pass. Certina's official FAQ says mechanical accuracy varies with the movement and the wearer's habits and that a qualified watchmaker can regulate a watch within undisclosed Certina tolerances. It does not publish a numerical Powermatic 80.611 or exact-reference bound.

The exact-reference specialist-retailer page publishes -10/+25 seconds per day, but it provides no test method, source attribution, serial-specific result, or manufacturer guarantee. Its upper bound also differs from Certina's own approximate -10/+30 guidance for most non-chronometers, so it is retained as rejected secondary evidence rather than normalized into the M1 row.

The owner discussion reports multi-day and positional readings for unnamed DS Action 38 mm/Powermatic 80 divers, including a six-day series, but never identifies exact reference C048.807.44.051.01 and explicitly mixes other 40.5 mm and PH1000M models. It cannot establish an exact-reference guaranteed accuracy bound.
